verdict.rationale: Team membership, role-based access, and scoped API keys are a fair governance question for a GPU cloud platform, so the axis applies. The pack never documents team members, roles, or key scoping. It shows only that a single Runpod API key authenticates the REST API, CLI and MCP server, and that billing is credit-based with auto-pay. Those are adjacent features, not team or credential governance controls.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can manage team members with roles and scoped API keys so credentials and spend stay controlled
